claims.description: A supply line burst in the unit above, 4B, early on Saturday. Water came through the living room ceiling and soaked the sofa, the rug, the television and two bookcases.

evidence.description: Living room ceiling with a wide water stain and wet drywall.
Soaked sofa and wool rug under the leak.
Television and soundbar on the wet media console.
Two bookcases with wet books on the lower shelves.
Incident report from the building manager, Larch Street Properties: burst supply line in unit 4B.
List of the damaged items with the year of purchase, written by Jordan Ellis.
Order confirmation for the television from East End Electronics, 479.99.
Card statement line for the soundbar, 199.00.
Web page of the same sofa model at today's price, 1,150.00.
Receipt for the wool rug from Hearth and Loom, 270.00.

asks.text: What caused the water, and did the building manager confirm it in writing?

answer.text: A supply line under the kitchen sink of unit 4B burst. The incident report of the building manager is attached.

asks.text: A list of the damaged items, with the year you bought each one.

answer.text: The list is attached. The sofa is from 2020, the rug from 2022, the television from 2024 and the soundbar from 2025.

asks.text: Proof of purchase for the television.

answer.text: The order confirmation is attached.

asks.text: Proof of purchase for the soundbar.

answer.text: I have no receipt. The attached card statement shows the purchase.

decisions.reason: Actual cash value after six years of use.
The receipt shows a price of 270.00.

lines.text: Two bookcases and their books: dry and clean
Coats and bedding from the hall closet: dry cleaning
Floor lamp, shorted by water: replace

decisions.reason: Drying the building is for the owner of the building. It is not personal property.

determinations.note: The sofa is approved at its actual cash value: 30 percent off for six years of use. The television and the soundbar wait for proof of purchase.
Proof of purchase is accepted for both items.
Two lines are approved. The dehumidifier dried the building, not your belongings.
The rug is now approved at its receipt price of 270.00. The payment of 8 April included 50.00 more than this.

disputes.reason: A new sofa of the same kind costs 1,150.00 today. The policy should pay what it costs to replace it.
disputes.note: This policy pays the actual cash value of furniture, not the price of a new one. The decision stands.

claims.description: My bicycle was stolen from the locked bike room in the basement of 48 Larch Street. The cable lock was cut. I found this on Saturday morning.

evidence.description: Cut cable lock on the floor of the bike room.
The bicycle in summer 2025: a grey hybrid with a rear rack.

asks.text: The police report number for the theft.
Proof that you owned the bicycle: a receipt, a serial number or a registration.

answer.text: I have no receipt. I bought the bicycle second hand in 2024. The attached photo shows it.

asks.text: Second request: the police report number. A theft claim cannot be decided without it.
Last request: the police report number. With no answer by 22 June, the claim will be closed.

claims.description: A hail storm hit while the car was parked at Cobbs Hill Park. There are dents on the hood, the roof, the trunk lid and the doors. The windshield and the rear glass are broken.

evidence.description: Hood and roof with many hail dents.
Broken windshield.
Broken rear glass.
Weather service storm report: hail up to 1.75 inches in Rochester on 16 July.
Odometer reading: 58,214 miles.
Right rear quarter panel on 2 July, with no dent.
Dealer listing: 2021 Honda CR-V EX-L, 55,100 miles, 20,400.00, Henrietta.
Dealer listing: 2021 Honda CR-V EX-L, 61,800 miles, 19,900.00, Victor.

asks.text: Photos of every damaged panel and of both broken windows.

answer.text: The photos are attached.

asks.text: The odometer reading, with a photo.

answer.text: 58,214 miles. The photo is attached.

asks.text: Can the car be driven safely?

answer.text: No. Both windows are broken, and the car is parked at home.

asks.text: If the car is a total loss, do you want to keep it? If you keep it, its salvage value is taken off the settlement.

answer.text: Yes. I want to keep the car and have it repaired myself.

asks.text: Is the title in your name, with no loan on the car?

answer.text: Yes. The title is in my name, and there is no loan.

lines.text: Windshield: replace, and recalibrate the camera
Four doors and both front fenders: paintless dent repair
Rear quarter panel, right: repair and paint

decisions.reason: The dent and the rust on this panel are older than the storm. They show in the photos of the June policy inspection.

determinations.note: The glass is approved so that the car can be made safe. The body lines wait for the total loss review.

disputes.reason: The right rear panel had no dent before the storm. The June photo shows a reflection, not a dent.

offers.basis: The repair cost of 15,347.55 is above 75 percent of the value. Actual cash value of 17,900.00 from three comparable vehicles within 100 miles, at 85,214 miles. Less 3,580.00 salvage value, because the owner keeps the vehicle.
Corrected for the odometer reading of 58,214 miles. Actual cash value of 18,650.00 from the same three comparable vehicles. Less 3,730.00 salvage value, because the owner keeps the vehicle.
The offer of 31 July expired with no answer. It is issued again with the same valuation.
offers.reason: The comparable vehicles in the valuation are a lower trim level. Two dealer listings of the same trim and mileage are near 20,000.00.

offers.basis: Revised with two comparable vehicles of the same trim level. Actual cash value of 19,350.00. Less 3,870.00 salvage value, because the owner keeps the vehicle.

claims.description: Another car ran the stop sign at Park Avenue and Berkeley Street and hit the right front of my car. The car was towed from the scene.

evidence.description: Right front corner: bumper, headlamp and fender.
Right front wheel pushed back in the wheel arch.
The other car and its plate.
Police accident report for the collision at Park Avenue and Berkeley Street.
Left side and rear of the car at the shop, with no damage.
Statement by Priya Ellis about the collision.
Letter from Lakeshore Collision Center: no aftermarket headlamp fits the adaptive LED unit of this model.
Rental invoice: compact car, 25 August to 3 September, 38.00 a day.
Photo from the shop after teardown: bent bumper reinforcement bar and crushed A/C condenser.
Photo from the shop: crack on the inner rim of the right front wheel, tire off.
Rental invoice: mid-size SUV, 3 to 19 September, 52.50 a day.
Final invoice from Lakeshore Collision Center, 6,296.15.

asks.text: Who was driving, and is that person listed on the policy?

answer.text: Priya Ellis was driving. She is a listed driver on the policy.

asks.text: Photos of the damage from four sides.

answer.text: The photos are attached.

asks.text: The name and the insurer of the other driver.

answer.text: Dale Whitcomb, insured with Northgate Insurance. Both are in the police report.

asks.text: Was the right front wheel damaged before this collision, for example by a curb?

answer.text: It had light curb marks on the rim. It was not bent or cracked before the collision.

asks.text: Photos from the shop of the right front wheel with the tire off.

answer.text: The photo from the shop is attached. The inner rim is cracked.

lines.text: Front bumper cover: replace and paint
Headlamp assembly, right, adaptive LED: replace

decisions.reason: Priced as an aftermarket part of like kind and quality.

lines.text: Fender, right front: replace and paint

decisions.reason: The wheel shows curb wear from before the loss. The photos show no damage from this collision.

lines.text: Wheel alignment, four wheels, and radar sensor recalibration

decisions.reason: Blend time is limited to 2.5 hours at the agreed labor rate.

determinations.note: Five lines are approved. The headlamp is priced as an aftermarket part. The wheel is denied.
The alignment and the recalibration are approved. The paint blend is approved for 2.5 hours of labor.
The photo shows a crack from the impact. The wheel is approved.

disputes.reason: The shop says that no aftermarket headlamp fits the adaptive LED unit of this car. Its letter is attached.
disputes.note: The letter from the shop is accepted. The original part is approved.

Left front door with a long scrape and a dent.
The steel post at the corner of the lot.

Screenshot of the trip list in the delivery app for 26 September.

asks.text: The lot is a pickup lane for delivery drivers. What was the car used for at the time of the loss?

answer.text: Yes. Sam has had a driver account since August.

lines.text: Fender, left front: replace and paint

decisions.reason: The car was used for paid delivery at the time of the loss. The policy excludes this use.

decisions.reason: The car was used for paid delivery at the time of the loss. The policy excludes this use.
The car was used for paid delivery at the time of the loss. The policy excludes this use.

decisions.reason: The car was used for paid delivery at the time of the loss. The policy excludes this use.

determinations.note: The approval of 2 October is withdrawn. The policy excludes a loss during paid delivery use.

disputes.reason: Sam had finished his last delivery and was leaving the lot. He was not on a paid trip at the time.
disputes.note: The trip list shows an active order from 19:38 to 20:02. The decision stands.
